entries.text: Write Primitives, Read Primitives and other primitives benchmarks at scale factor 1 no longer corrupt native memory while writing their 1M-row staging files from zstd-compressed TPC-H data, which crashed in-process engines such as DuckDB and SQLite with a double-linked-list abort or a segfault. The staging files are now written line by line instead of through an Arrow streaming reader that was abandoned mid-stream.
